intro: Sister Aquinne is an acolyte of Elune residing within the serene Temple Gardens of Darnassus. A novice priestess, she is studying under the Priesthood of Elune at the Temple of the Moon.

p: Sister Aquinne has dedicated herself to the Priesthood of Elune in the night elf capital. Stationed in the tranquil Temple Gardens beneath the shadow of the Temple of the Moon, she continues her studies under the guidance of the High Priestess and elder sisters. When a once-great creature of the forest was in need of help, it was Aquinne who sent willing travelers to Priestess A'moora inside the temple to learn what had to be done.
